effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] trait and 1 card with the [App Driver] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
link_effect_description_eng: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
